text: Added and exported `triage` in `src/agents.ts` (plus from `src/index.ts`): it never answers order/refund questions itself, delegating via two wrapper tools (`askOrderAgent`, `askRefundAgent`) that call `orderAgent.chat().send()` / `refundAgent.chat().send()`.
